definition_quote.value: "genetic counseling" means a communication process that may include: (1) estimating the likelihood of occurrence or recurrence of any potentially inherited or genetically influenced condition or congenital abnormality...(2) helping an individual, family or health care provider to appreciate the medical, psychological and social implications of a disorder...(3) facilitating an individual's or family's exploration of the perception of risk and burden associated with a genetic disorder
